name: Brutus
title: First consul (legend)
note: Legendary founder of the Roman Republic

name: Camillus
title: Consul and dictator
note: Repelled the Gauls. "Second founder of Rome"

name: Scipio Africanus
title: Consul and general
note: Defeated Hannibal in the Second Punic War

name: Marius
title: Consul (7 times) and general
note: Military reform. Jugurthine and Cimbrian wars

name: Pompey
title: Triumvir and general
note: Mithridatic wars. Civil war with Caesar

name: Cicero
title: Consul and orator
note: "The state is ruled by law." Executed by Antony

name: Julius Caesar
title: Dictator for life
note: Conquered Gaul. Julian calendar. Adopted Octavian

name: Mark Antony
title: General (triumvir)
note: Allied with Cleopatra, defeated by Octavian
